Our Story

Rooted in Bidar,reaching the world.

Ranaveer
Founder & CEO, Bharat Traders Bioelectronics Engineer — REVA University, Bengaluru 📍 Bidar, North Karnataka

I grew up in Bidar — a district where most young people's plan is simple: get a government job, leave for Bangalore or Hyderabad, don't look back. I moved to Bengaluru, studied Bioelectronics Engineering at REVA University, then did something that made no sense to most people around me.

I started an export company. Not a tech startup. Not an app. An agri-export company — shipping bananas, rice, fruits, and pulses from Indian farms to Gulf supermarkets.

"The same banana selling for ₹12/kg at a Karnataka farm sells for ₹240/kg in a Dubai supermarket. Somewhere in that gap is an opportunity — and a responsibility."

Bharat Traders is my answer to a question I grew up asking: why does Bidar stay behind while the rest moves forward? I'm building that answer — one shipment, one farmer, one Gulf buyer at a time.

📱 @bharattraders_global — Follow us on Instagram
  • 🌱Direct farm sourcing — No middlemen, full traceability from field to port
